name: Peptide Evidence Index
description: Per peptide: how strong the human evidence is, the FDA status, and how many sources and dose protocols come from studies, regulators, guides and communities.
citation: TruePeptideSource. (2026). Peptide Evidence Index (Version 2026-11-07) [Data set]. https://truepeptidesource.com/data

fields.human_trials: none | limited | moderate | strong: how much human trial evidence exists.
fields.animal_only: true when the only evidence is animal or cell studies.
fields.fda_status: approved | approved_other_indication | investigational | compounding_category_1 | compounding_category_2 | compounding_category_3 | hhs_503a_enforcement_discretion | not_evaluated | removed_or_withdrawn | unknown.
fields.sources: Distinct sources cited on the page, by origin. A page cited for two origins counts once under each. protocol_sites: doses published on other peptide sites, unverified by any study.
fields.distinct_source_urls: Distinct source URLs, whatever their origin.
fields.protocols: Dose protocols by origin label. A protocol takes the weakest origin among its sources, so a dose backed by a trial and a forum counts as community.
fields.protocols_study_or_regulator: Protocols labelled clinical study or regulatory: every source behind them is a study or a regulator.
